summary: JKHive specialist routines (Acidity, Vacuum Packing, Food Washing, Sous Vide). Backend 18/18 pytest pass: list/create/delete CRUD, pass/fail logic, _id excluded, 401/403 unauth, 404 unknown delete, 400 empty use_by_date, sanitiser-specific PPM bands, sous-vide target/actual logic. Frontend partially validated: /jkhive/routines/more shows all 4 tiles enabled (no 'Soon' badge); direct-nav guard /jkhive/acidity/record -> /jkhive/acidity/pick works (URL change confirmed). Deeper E2E flows could not be completed because subsequent /jkhive/<feature> page loads produced HTTP 403 on /api/admin/* despite a valid admin login (cookies/CSRF likely lost across goto in the automation context); same login successfully renders MoreRoutines and 4 tile testids — so this is an automation-session artifact, not necessarily a product bug. Backend smoke via curl from main agent + 18 pytest assertions confirm the integration contract end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: After admin login and one successful navigation, subsequent goto() to /jkhive/acidity, /jkhive/vacuum-packing, /jkhive/food-washing, /jkhive/sous-vide returned cascading 403 from /api/admin/cooking-cooling/catalog and /api/admin/<feature>. MoreRoutines works fine on the same session. This blocked the full E2E (pick → record → submit → done) inside automation. Recommend main agent self-test in real browser — if it reproduces, inspect axios withCredentials / cookie SameSite or the 403 interceptor that may redirect-on-error.

action_items: Main agent: self-test the four /jkhive specialist flows in a real browser (mobile 414x896) — Acidity/Vacuum/Washing/SousVide pick→record→submit→done. Backend is fully green.
If the 403 cascade reproduces in a real session, inspect axios withCredentials and the cooling-catalog endpoint auth path; otherwise mark closed.
critical_code_review_comments: All four routes correctly exclude _id (find with {_id:0} and dict comprehension on insert response). Good.
vacuum_packing.py validates empty use_by_date with 400 — correct.
food_washing.py uses Pydantic Literal for sanitiser, good input safety.
Pass logic is centralised per route and unit-testable; threshold constants (PH_TARGET, PACK_TEMP_MAX, ppm bands) are at module top — clear.
Frontend specialist Pick reuses cooking-cooling/catalog endpoint — good DRY across Cooling/Deliveries/Specialists.
AcidityRecord/VacuumRecord/WashingRecord/SousVideRecord all guard direct nav with <Navigate to='.../pick' replace />. Verified for acidity (URL changed correctly).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_jkhive_specialists.py — 18 cases for acidity/vacuum/washing/sous-vide CRUD + pass logic + auth + 404. Login URL is /admin-login (NOT /admin/login or /login) with data-testids admin-email-input / admin-password-input / admin-login-submit. JKHive tiles use testid prefix 'tile-' (e.g. tile-food-acidity). MoreRoutines includes Layout that needs JKHive home visited first to seed adminLocationId in LocationContext. If you hit cascading 403 in the automation browser like this iteration, switch to verifying via the pytest file (already covers everything end-to-end at the API).
rca of the issue: No backend or product bug detected. Frontend automation hit a session-cookie / interceptor edge case where goto() to /jkhive/<feature> after a successful login produced 403 from /api/admin/cooking-cooling/catalog and the four specialist endpoints, even though the same session loaded /jkhive/routines/more cleanly with all 4 tile testids. Root cause is most likely cookie SameSite=Lax interaction with Playwright cross-context navigation in this preview hostname — main agent self-test in a real browser is recommended.
